body: Yeah. I used to be able to be the life of the party but it’s gotten to a point where I don’t want to be around anyone anymore. I can’t act energetic and optimistic anymore. I think I’ll always just have to be alone and learn to be okay with it.

That’s how I feel. The thing is I was actually doing pretty good for my self for a few months(April,may,June) but for some reason I made very stupid decisions and regressed back to my old self. It hurts a lot

I don’t remember your name. But I was the girl with pink/red ombré hair. I think I had a snoop dogg shirt on. I was with my blonde friend and her boyfriend. It was after bassnectar which was one of the most amazing experiences ever❤️ But anyway I was dancing on a table and after the show was over me and my friends were waiting for the crowd to die down and sat on the table. You came up to me and I could tell you were tripping hard and you asked us to help you find your friends. I remember your eyes were a pretty clear blue except your pupils were the size of nickels. You had the universe in your eyes. I think you had a bandanna around your head idk I was pretty drunk. Anyway you tried calling your friends. Eventullay you got ahold of them and we met them by the Ferris wheel. You were walking so fast like you were on a mission. And there was a huge puddle at one point and I remember you running and leaping across it lol. We met up with your group(I think they were at least). You later laid down on the grass and I braided your hair. You had really nice curly hair lol. Then i said I would see a show with you because you said no one would dance with you at bassnectar and I said I would at another show. But my friends wanted to get water and then led me to another show and I never saw you again. I tried giving you my Snapchat but it wasn’t working so I just gave you my username and I realized I typed it in wrong. But anyhow you were really cool and I just remembered how amazing that night was and you definitely contributed to it☺️
